frameTimeEvidence: Baseline measure run (no screencast): rAF sampler at the settled spawn view collected 8 frame deltas, median 9,689 ms (~0.10 fps under SwiftShader); at static P1 the sampler collected 0 deltas in ~4 min (renderer emits no frames at a static pose on current main).
salvage: The film pass (film.mjs v2, early screencast) was killed by a VM restart at 361 s, after presenting (18,234 calls / 7,757,846 tris, deterministic) and 278 captured frames. The teleport evaluate timed out in that pass, so the captured frames cover load-in + the spawn view only (no P1 segment). Per-frame screencast timestamps lived only in the killed process's memory, so the MP4 is encoded at the measured average pacing of the capture window (278 frames over ~350 s = 1.26 s/frame uniform). Captured-frame count is exact; per-frame timing is an average, not per-frame truth.
